viewpoints.expectation: From the wake-up spot the boathouse reads as a cold maritime shed, and the workbench with the pistol reads first. It should not read as a grey room.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §9 step 1; PresentationPassPlan.txt §4

viewpoints.expectation: From the doorway the path, the stones, and the lake read as a cold freshwater shore before any glow does.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §9 step 2; LongTermPlan.txt §18

viewpoints.expectation: Looking west along the path, the flickering mast lamp above the boathouse roof pulls the eye toward the Survey Launch.
viewpoints.source: Design/game_design.md Wrecked Survey Launch; PresentationPassPlan.txt §9

viewpoints.subject: Relay rig
viewpoints.expectation: The scavenger camp reads as rusted industrial scrap around a relay that is still live, and the relay housing reads first.
viewpoints.source: Design/game_design.md Shore Watch; LongTermPlan.txt §18

viewpoints.subject: Relay rig
viewpoints.expectation: The same camp after the coil route is complete: the relay reads cold and empty, and the scrap around it is unchanged.
viewpoints.source: Design/game_design.md Shore Watch coil route; PresentationPassPlan.txt §9 step 3

viewpoints.subject: boat.mara
viewpoints.expectation: Mara's lookout reads as one person watching the path from behind the ridge, out of the scavenger's sight, and Mara reads first.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §9 step 3; Design/game_design.md Shore Watch

viewpoints.subject: Salt-stiff cot
viewpoints.expectation: The cot reads as a folding army camp bed with a stiff canvas sleeping surface, low to the ground, not a white block. Someone could have slept there.
viewpoints.source: Presentation Pass playtest 1 (2026-09-29): the cot was a white block

viewpoints.subject: boat.mara
viewpoints.expectation: Mara reads as a person in a cold-weather jacket, teal and faded, standing normally (not in a T-pose or a reference pose), and distinct from the scavenger.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §6 PP-08; Design/world_bible.md (no fixed face or backstory)

viewpoints.expectation: At conversation range Mara has her own face: a woman with dark hair tied back, weathered skin, visibly not the scavenger's head. Skin reads as skin, not grey.
viewpoints.source: Presentation Pass playtest 1 (2026-09-29): Mara and the scavenger looked like twins

viewpoints.expectation: Same framing as mara_face, after the coil route, with Mara on the Landing Stage deck: her head sits on her neck exactly as it does at the lookout.
viewpoints.source: Phase 5 acceptance playtest (Anthony, 2026-09-30): Mara looks weird at the landing

viewpoints.subject: boat.scavenger
viewpoints.expectation: The scavenger reads as a rust-brown jacketed figure with a pack, standing normally and clearly different from Mara.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §6 PP-08

viewpoints.expectation: The Survey Launch reads as a wrecked boat on the stones, oxidized hull first, before the live-water glow.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §9 step 5; LongTermPlan.txt §18

viewpoints.expectation: The water reads as dark freshwater with an electrical shimmer and a ring of dead fish, and the glow reads as the danger.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §4; Design/game_design.md Wrecked Survey Launch

viewpoints.expectation: The same view after the leads are pulled: the glow and the sparks are gone, and the water and the dead-fish ring are still there.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §4 and §9 step 5; Design/game_design.md Wrecked Survey Launch

viewpoints.subject: Breaker panel
viewpoints.expectation: The breaker panel reads as a gutted marine panel, with careful cuts and taped ends, not a grey box.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §6 breaker_panel; Design/art_pipeline.md art direction

viewpoints.subject: Battery bank
viewpoints.expectation: The battery bank reads as old marine cells in a split box, with the leads running toward the water.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §6 battery_bank; Design/game_design.md Wrecked Survey Launch

viewpoints.subject: Depth sounder
viewpoints.expectation: The depth sounder reads as a boat instrument with a paper roll, not a grey box.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §6 depth_sounder; Design/art_pipeline.md art direction

viewpoints.subject: Name board
viewpoints.expectation: The name board reads as a flaked painted board, peeling white and teal, with the letters T_RN still readable.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §6 name_board_tern; Design/game_design.md Wrecked Survey Launch

viewpoints.expectation: Seen edge-on from the west, the name board is attached to something: it rests against the bow or stands on posts in the stones. It does not hover in the air.
viewpoints.source: Presentation Pass playtest 2 (2026-09-29): the TERN sign looked like it floats

viewpoints.expectation: The life jackets lie on the stones. They do not stand up or hover, and the straps read as cut.
viewpoints.source: Presentation Pass playtest 2 (2026-09-29): the life jackets looked like they float

viewpoints.subject: Emergency beacon
viewpoints.expectation: The emergency beacon reads as a small boat beacon with a white crust at the base, not a grey box, and it is not lost against the transom.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §6 emergency_beacon; Design/game_design.md Wrecked Survey Launch

viewpoints.subject: Dead fish
viewpoints.expectation: The dead fish reads as a small pale fish on the stones with the ring of others beyond it, not a white block.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §6 dead_fish; Design/game_design.md Wrecked Survey Launch

viewpoints.expectation: The bench pickups (pistol, rounds, dressing) read as small objects a person would take, not grey boxes.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §6 and §9 step 1

viewpoints.subject: Chalk warning
viewpoints.expectation: The chalk warning reads as a plank in the stones with a hurried warning about the water, readable before anyone steps in.
viewpoints.source: Design/game_design.md Wrecked Survey Launch; PresentationPassPlan.txt §9 step 5

viewpoints.expectation: An inspect message is open over a bright view out the lake window, and the words stay readable on that background.
viewpoints.source: PresentationPassPlan.txt §2 and mission; Design/game_design.md decisions log 2026-09-29

viewpoints.expectation: From the door, a timber landing someone uses: a lit lantern, a string of bulbs, a skiff tied alongside, a half-packed crate under a lean-to. It reads as a place before any text does.
viewpoints.source: Design/POIs/shore.landing_stage.md Review Views; WorldStatePhasePlan.txt §2

viewpoints.expectation: Same camera after the coil route: Mara stands on the stage beside a closed, lashed crate and her pack, and the skiff is loaded. The difference from landing_far reads at a glance.
viewpoints.source: Design/POIs/shore.landing_stage.md Review Views; WorldStatePhasePlan.txt §2 coil route

viewpoints.expectation: Same camera after the kill route: no warm light at the lantern, no skiff alongside (a shape far out on the water), the crate open with its lid on the boards. It reads as a place shut down, not a texture swap.
viewpoints.source: Design/POIs/shore.landing_stage.md Review Views; WorldStatePhasePlan.txt §2 combat route

viewpoints.expectation: Same camera with the Survey Launch's leads pulled: the bulbs along the stage are dark; everything else is as in landing_far.
viewpoints.source: Design/POIs/shore.landing_stage.md Review Views; WorldStatePhasePlan.txt §2 power cut

viewpoints.expectation: The crate at interaction range: half packed, its lid leaning against it, the tins and the rolled blanket reading as supplies.
viewpoints.source: Design/POIs/shore.landing_stage.md Review Views and Environmental Story clue 2

viewpoints.expectation: Same camera after the coil route: the lid is on, rope lashing round the crate, her pack beside it.
viewpoints.source: Design/POIs/shore.landing_stage.md Review Views

viewpoints.expectation: Same camera after the kill route: the crate is empty and the lid lies on the boards where it was thrown.
viewpoints.source: Design/POIs/shore.landing_stage.md Review Views

viewpoints.expectation: From the stage after the kill route: the skiff is far out in the channel, turned, empty. It reads as a boat cut loose, not a boat that belongs out there.
viewpoints.source: Design/POIs/shore.landing_stage.md Review Views

viewpoints.expectation: Mara's lookout after the coil route: empty. No Mara and no pack; the lookout crate and the shed are as they were.
viewpoints.source: Design/POIs/shore.landing_stage.md Review Views; WorldStatePhasePlan.txt §2 coil route

route.expectation: The walk from the boathouse door, past the scavenger camp, and on to the Survey Launch beach stays one continuous cold shore.
